author: Inside Edition
description: A woman on a walk along the shore near San Diego suddenly captured a terrifying sight on her phone: a surfer being slammed into sharp rocks by a powerful wave. The witness, 39-year-old Benita Karo, tells Inside Edition she took action fast, jumping into the water fully-clothed. Bystanders called 911 and the surfer was rushed to the hospital. Now, the surfer, 75-year-old Bob Asselin, says Karo saved his life.
title: 'Hero Mom' Rescues Surfer From Rocks Collision

author: Inside Edition
description: In June 2024, Nora Rowland had not heard from her ailing father, retired architect Robert Rowland, in weeks. She drove to his South Carolina home to find out that Robert had died three days earlier. She was also shocked to learn that his former caretaker had taken ownership of his house. That caretaker, identified as Sarah Smalls, has now been arrested. Smalls has been charged with perjury, breach of trust and exploitation of a vulnerable adult. She posted $45,000 bail.
title: Caretaker Of Late Architect Arrested For Allegedly Stealing His Home

author: Inside Edition
description: Thealleged drugging and gang rape of a Cornell University student by seven fraternity members continues to grip the nation. It's shining a light on sexual assault on college campuses. The Cornell incident allegedly happened during a time of the Fall semester known as the 'Red Zone,' when most attacks on campuses are reported to happen. As Inside Edition's Justin Finch reports, the statistics are shocking.
title: What Is The College Campus 'Red Zone?'

description:
Sponsored Content by RoC Skincare.

Inside Edition teamed up with RoC® Skincare and its paid partner, dermatologist Dr. Sheila Farhang, for tips to get younger looking skin. Dr. Farhang says one solution is getting a chemical peel, but that can be expensive and cause side effects like burning and peeling. She recommends RoC's Line Smoothing 2-Step Peel Pads as an at-home, cost-effective solution.
title: Dermatologist-Recommended At-Home Treatment For Younger Looking Skin

author: Inside Edition
description: Sheriffs in Tampa, Florida were called to rescue a hawk trapped in a pool enclosure. The initial capture was easy. But because the hawk was feisty, the release required a little more patience. The bird of prey, understandably spooked by the human, made sure to give her a hard time and inflict a little pain. After a few minutes, the patient Hillsborough County sheriff's deputy safely released the bird. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Feisty Hawk Rescued From Pool Enclosure

author: Inside Edition
description: A 6-year-old girl named Payton was found safe after she wandered away from home and ended up lost in the woods. Payton lost her way after chasing three dogs at her great-grandmother's home in rural Little Lake, Michigan. After a five-hour search, little Payton was located and rescued; that joyous moment was caught on camera. Afterward, the little girl spoke with Inside Edition and shared an important lesson she learned.
title: 6-Year-Old Girl Found Safe After Getting Lost In Woods

author: Inside Edition
description: An Arizona road turned into a river, sweeping away at least one vehicle. The driver was stranded 30 feet from dry land, causing rescuers to intervene. An aviation crew was tasked with saving the man. A helicopter hovered while a rescuer was lowered down to get him. Rescuers say emergency crews were busy all across the region. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Driver Airlifted To Safety After Car Swept Away By Flood
